purpose: Teach: うり/錦/メロディー/ギリシア/壁紙/禅/春樹/マニアック

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、夏のうり、お祖父ちゃんち、ふんだんに、出てくるんだよね、毎年。
lines.en: Riku — you know how Grandpa's place always has tons of summer melons? Every single year.
lines.style: Bright, conversational opening. Natural teen energy. Casual and inclusive, drawing him into shared memory. Warm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。修学旅行、京都の錦市場、自由時間に、行きたいよな。
lines.en: Yeah. We're going to Kyoto for the school trip, and honestly, I really want to check out Nishiki Market during free time.
lines.style: Genuine interest breaking through cool exterior. Slight lean forward energy. Earnest beneath the casual tone. Not trying to impress, just admitting what he wants.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 軽音部、新曲のメロディー、皆で、決めようよ、文化祭、もうすぐ。
lines.en: Hey — the light music club needs to decide on the melody for our new song, and the culture festival is coming up so soon. We should all work it out together.
lines.style: Animated, moving energy forward. Slight urgency without panic. Collaborative tone — pulling him in as part of something. Warm insistence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 世界史で、古代ギリシアの単元、結構、面白いと思う、俺。
lines.en: I've been finding the ancient Greece unit in world history pretty interesting, actually. More than I expected.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost surprised at his own interest. Slower pace, genuine. Admits something sincere without performance. Quiet conviction on 'pretty interesting.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 自分の部屋の壁紙、お洒落なのに、変えたいんだ、最近、私。
lines.en: I've been thinking about changing the wallpaper in my room lately. It's nice now, but I want something different.
lines.style: Soft, almost tentative. Admitting something small and personal. Not seeking approval, just thinking aloud. Slight trailing-off quality, like she's letting him in on a quiet decision.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 禅の本、図書室で、借りたんだ、心、落ち着けたくて、最近。
lines.en: I borrowed this Zen book from the library. I've been wanting to calm my mind down a bit lately, you know?
lines.style: Earnest and unguarded. Slower, deliberate pace. Not defensive about needing calm — just stating a fact. Vulnerability wrapped in quietness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、村上春樹、読んだことある?難しいって、聞いた、結構。
lines.en: Have you ever read Murakami Haruki? I heard his stuff is supposed to be pretty difficult.
lines.style: Curious, genuine question. Slight lift on the opening — real interest in what he thinks. Not testing, just asking. Warm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のSNSの投稿、マニアックだよね、たまに、ついていけないぜ、桜。
lines.en: Your SNS posts are kind of out there sometimes, you know? Honestly, I can't always keep up with what you're on about, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate complaint wrapped in gentle teasing. Close-friend rhythm — he's allowed to say this. Slight laugh underneath. Exasperated but fond.
